name: Custom Start
author: Lemril
description:
Custom game start that let you choose your ship from a predefined selection.
 This mod is planned to be a base, you can edit it to your desire (with a text editor), there is a csv with each line that reference a variant that can be found here starsector-core\data\variants 
 Ex. : Shrike : shrike_Attack : ngcModAncienExplorerEscort2Shrike,NewGameOptionSelected,$option == ngcModAncienExplorerEscort2Shrike,NGCAddShip shrike_Attack
